title: Cartwise Grocery Orders Limit-Review Days Credit Schedule
content:
## Cartwise Grocery Orders — limit-review days credit schedule

A days credit is added to the limit-review claim amount of a Cartwise Grocery Orders limit-review claim after that amount has been rounded to the cent. It turns on the calendar days since the order's completion and the units billed on the claimed line.

| Calendar days from the completion date to today | Units billed on the claimed line | Days credit |
|---|---|---|
| 2 or more | at least 2 | 1.50 |
| 2 or more | a single unit (fewer than 2) | 1.00 |
| 0 or 1 | any | none |

**Clause.** When at least 2 calendar days have passed from the date of completion to today and at least 2 units were billed on the claimed line, the days credit is 1.50; when at least 2 calendar days have passed and a single unit was billed, it is 1.00; otherwise there is none.

**Counting.** Days run in calendar days from the date part of the order's completion time to today's date; the time of day does not count. Units are the quantity billed on the claimed line's billed line entry.

**Schedule notes (hypothetical dates).**
- Completed 4 June, today 6 June: 2 calendar days; a 3-unit line takes 1.50, a 1-unit line takes 1.00.
- Completed 4 June at 23:50, today 5 June: 1 calendar day; no credit.
- A hypothetical claim amount of 16.50 on a 2-unit line, 5 days after completion: 18.00 once the credit is added.
